name: Dulce Tropical Restaurant & Café
address: 841 NE 125th St, North Miami, FL 33161, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mandy Bairos
reviewSamples.text:
The food was absolutely phenomenal! I ordered two pabellón and cheese empanadas, a pabellón arepa with shredded beef, black beans, plantains, and cheese, two Pabellón a Caballo meals, and passion fruit juice. Everything was delicious!

I arrived close to closing and ordered takeout. The service was friendly, and finding free street parking was a nice bonus. The chairs felt a little narrow and uncomfortable while I waited, but that was my only small critique. I would definitely go back! 🇻🇪

reviewSamples.author: Photo of tommy balli
reviewSamples.text: Needing to stop by our North Miami Office,  we were in breakfast mode and decided to stop by Dulce Tropical for breakfast.   Right off the bat...freshly made coffee(breakfast served all day),   menus on smart tablets,   and friendly service.    The food was fantastic, the coffee was outstanding,  and the vibe was that of a small coffee shop.   Give Dulce Tropical a shot for eats next time you are in North Miami!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Dusan Bjelan
reviewSamples.text: Amazing authentic Venezuelan food at a very reasonable price. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and made with care. The staff was super friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend trying the cachapa and the empanadas. So delicious! Definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to. Highly recommended! 5+++

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Sabrina
reviewSamples.text: You’d think there’s no way an order of empanada can go wrong. It was the most disgusting food I’ve ever eaten. Literally I felt like I was swallowing old oil. The empanada was DRIPPING in old oil , it was so saggy and sooooo bad. Can’t imagine how other food is. Disgusting .

reviewSamples.author: Photo of robert anderson
reviewSamples.text: I was blown away how great this place was. Food amazing, service amazing and they give you big portions that are just delicious!! Definitely coming back!!
